NORTHWIND PRECISION MACHINING LLC - SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT
Access Control Policy (AC-POL-01) v2.1
1 Purpose
This policy defines how access to the CUI enclave is granted and reviewed.
2 Policy
Authorized users are identified by unique accounts issued by IT after manager approval.
Processes acting on behalf of authorized users run under named service accounts.
Devices authorized to connect to the enclave are recorded in the asset inventory.
Least privilege shall be applied; privileged accounts are separate from everyday accounts.
Session lock activates after 15 minutes of inactivity with pattern-hiding displays.
Visitors must be escorted at all times and the visitor log is retained for one year.
